text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Syrian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara reviews with his Vatican counterpart Jean Louis Touran developments in the region and the situation in the Israeli-occupied Arab lands.
- Arab League chief Esmat Abdel-Meguid and European envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos discuss peace process and bilateral cooperation.
- President Assad and Lebanese President Elias Hrawi discuss situation in the region, contacts made by the concerned sides over the peace process and bilateral cooperation.
- Arab and international media highlight the Syrian-Egyptian summit and Assad's commitment to return Arab rights.
- Arab investment committee and foreign and Saudi partners won approval for an olive and olive oil production project.
- Israel repeats that it will not withdraw from the Golan and Europe confirms commitment to the land-for peace principle.
- Turkish chief of staff will arrive in Tel Aviv today.
- The Syrian Arab airline establishment agrees an investment plan of 200 million pounds (around $4 million) for 1997.
